title: Translate a delivered datasheet/report (domain reviewer)
context: Translating a delivered reanalysis datasheet or methods report into additional languages widens the community reach of the project's outputs, particularly for researchers and educators in non-English-speaking countries. The translation requires both language proficiency and domain-specific knowledge (proteomics, reproducibility concepts) to avoid mistranslation of technical terms. A domain reviewer with the target language must sign off before publication. The source document must already be delivered and CC-BY-4.0 licensed.
objective: Produce an accurate translation of one delivered reanalysis datasheet or methods report into a target language, reviewed and approved by a domain reviewer with the relevant language competence.
acceptanceCriteria: A delivered CC-BY-4.0 datasheet or methods report (from datasheet-016 or report-011) is selected as the source document.
The translation accurately renders all technical terms (proteomics, FDR, run manifest, immutable digest, etc.) in the target language without introducing ambiguity or error.
A domain reviewer with both the target language and proteomics/reproducibility competence reviews and approves the translation before publication.
The 'not medical advice' notice, attribution requirements, and 'research artifact' framing are preserved in the translation.
The translated document is licensed CC-BY-4.0 with attribution to the original source document; committed to the project repo.
output: A committed translation of one reanalysis datasheet or methods report, approved by a domain reviewer with the target language, licensed CC-BY-4.0.
